metadata.title: Build and Update a List
metadata.description: Create a three-element list and replace an element using zero-based indexing.

instructions.main: Build `items = [10, 20, 30]`, then set index 1 to `99` — the list must end as `[10, 99, 30]`.
steps: Python numbers indexes from 0, so index 1 is the second element.

hints.message: Python lists are 0-based: the second element is index 1, not 2. `items[2] = 99` changes the third element, leaving your list as [10, 20, 99].

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: Your list is built and index 1 holds 99 — [10, 99, 30].

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: items is [10, 99, 30] with 99 stored at index 1.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: After running, `items` must be [10, 99, 30] — check which index you assigned to; Python counts from 0.
